entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Man, that detective from yesterday[n]really pissed me off! We're some kinda[n]threat?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's see him do it, then!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If someone else could help 'em,[n]we wouldn't be doin' stuff as the[n]Phantom Thieves to start with!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ow.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You're being way too loud.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Who cares? Everybody's talkin' about[n]this stuff anyways.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It'd just be more suspicious if we were[n]whisperin'.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, you really just gonna keep eatin'[n]and eatin' and eatin' those things all by[n]yourself!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Gimme some!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Sorry, just ate the last one.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You guys are too laid back. The police[n]are getting involved now, you know.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So you think it's true? We'll be okay if[n]we keep doing this... right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We can't let the cops scare us outta[n]bein' phantom thieves.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But... what about that weird guy from[n]Madarame's Palace? Isn't there a lot[n]we don't know?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The hell?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You three seem to be having so much[n]fun. I'm a little jealous.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Are you snoopin' on us again?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We said before, we don't know nothin'.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Why do you think I'm here to[n]question you?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Could it be that you're hiding something?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: My ears are always open to the troubles[n]of my peers, you know.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You're really that hungry for a good letter[n]of recommendation? Of course you are.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Nobody would take on your annoying job[n]if they weren't.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What's that supposed to mean?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...You're student council president,[n]right? Wouldn't you have known[n]about Kamoshida?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Of course not! He honestly was a good[n]teacher until that day...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, but you always take the teacher's[n]side. That's what a good council[n]president does, right?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Then... how about you? What did you do[n]for your friend?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You were much closer to her than I was,[n]so how did you help?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: There wasn't any way to help! By myself...[n]I couldn't do anything for her!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There's no need to shout.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If those Phantom Thieves are out[n]there helpin' people... I'd root for 'em,[n]no questions asked.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: They've gotta be more dependable than[n]some people I know.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Just make sure you show up to your[n]classes, all right?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You know what I asked earlier about[n]whether we'll be okay if we keep this up?[n]I take it back.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'd be ashamed to let it end now...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hell yeah. It's about time we find[n]our next target too.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If only I could...
